evidence.claim: The Free organization plan is distinct from the billable Developer plan. Adding a payment method upgrades to Developer; paid balances do not preserve a free request price.
Limits apply by organization and model. Request headers are daily requests; token headers are tokens/minute. Exact limits are account-specific; daily reset timezone is undocumented.
Speech-to-text has a 10-second minimum billed length; reserve this floor conservatively with the audio quota.

Open a hosted NIM model and use Get API Key for the API catalog.
Use this grant only within its prototyping/research/development terms. Numeric account quotas remain unknown until provider evidence supplies them.

evidence.claim: Free models share 20 RPM and 50 RPD, or 1000 RPD after at least $10 lifetime purchased credits. GET /key monetary usage is not free-request usage; /credits requires a management key.
Free requests should use exact free variants and provider.max_price zero to prevent paid provider fallback; billable plug-ins remain excluded.

steps: Create an inference API key; management privileges are unnecessary.
At least $10 lifetime purchased credits raises the shared free-model daily request allowance to 1000; it does not make paid models free.
Use GET /key only for key metadata; its dollar usage is not the free request counter.

evidence.claim: Only selected model operations have a free tier; paid project billing does not inherit free pricing. Models listing is not pricing or account entitlement.
Rate limits are per project, not key; input TPM and requests have separate limits. Daily requests reset at midnight America/Los_Angeles. Exact current limits appear in AI Studio.
September 2026 standard API-key retirement requires current AI Studio authorization keys, bound to service accounts. Auth migration errors must not be labeled quota exhaustion.

steps: Create a current AI Studio authorization key for the intended project.
Confirm project billing is disabled for Free tier use; a paid key does not retain free-model pricing.
Check the project rate limits in AI Studio. Keys in one project share allowance.

evidence.claim: Free Workers AI account: 10000 shared neurons/day reset midnight UTC; free plan hard rejects excess. Paid Workers accounts can bill overage, and specified frontier models require payment.
Account-specific model search requires Workers AI read/write permission and pagination. Model price conversion and paid-required exclusions need separate reviewed evidence.

steps: Create an API token restricted to your account with Account / Workers AI / Read for catalog discovery.
Inference needs Account / Workers AI / Edit; do not grant DNS, zone or unrelated account permissions.
Copy the account ID. Confirm the account is on Workers Free; paid overage is excluded without provider-enforced no-charge protection.

evidence.claim: Free mode includes monthly usage with limits shown per account/model. Pay-as-you-go extends usage and can bill overage; a balance top-up does not establish a larger free grant.
Optional admin-key GET /admin/rate-limit, /admin/spend-limit and /admin/usage expose limits/usage. An inference key need not have admin permissions; forbidden admin access leaves limits unknown.

steps: Create a regular inference API key in your organization.
Confirm the organization remains in Free mode; review the Limits page for its monthly and model limits.
An admin API key is optional for read-only billing/limit discovery and is not required by this wizard.

evidence.claim: Trial/evaluation keys have 1000 shared API calls/month and model-specific endpoint rates; production keys are paid even when their rate caps look similar. Trial is recurring monthly evaluation allowance, not a signup balance.
Native model listing supports page_size up to 1000, page_token and next_page_token; endpoints and deprecation metadata determine supported operations.

steps: Create a trial/evaluation key in the Cohere dashboard.
Do not replace it with a production key for the free profile.

evidence.claim: Global GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash have zero input/output price. FlashX and GLM-5.3-Flash are paid. Built-in web search costs $0.01/use.

Use the exact reviewed free Flash variants; disable built-in web search and paid add-ons.

Public cloud model list is not starter eligibility. Direct cloud IDs differ from local -cloud aliases. Model retirements and billing terms require independent review.

steps: Create an Ollama account and cloud API key.
Keep the account on the Free starter tier for this grant; paid add-on balance is not recurring free entitlement.
Record the signup date and current starter model allowance from the account page; public model listing does not supply them.
